SELECT COMPANY_CODE ,PU_CODE ,PU_NAME ,DIVISION_CODE ,DIVISION_NAME ,VENDOR_CODE ,VENDOR_NAME ,ORDER_NO ,ORDER_SEQ ,WAREHOUSING_TYPE ,ORDER_NO AS WAREHOUSING_NO ,WAREHOUSING_AMOUNT ,AMOUNT ,ORDER_EMP_NO ,ORDER_EMP_NAME /*,WAREHOUSING_TYPE_NAME*/ ,NONCOO_CNT_BU || ' / ' || NONCOO_CNT_TT AS NONCOO_CNT_BU ,ITEM_CODE ,ITEM_NAME ,COO_CERTIFY_NO /*,TAX_CERT_NO */ ,ORIGIN_FILE_NAME ,FILE_PATH FROM ( SELECT COMPANY_CODE ,PU_CODE ,NULL AS PU_NAME ,DIVISION_CODE ,DIVISION_NAME ,VENDOR_CODE ,VENDOR_NAME ,ORDER_NO ,ORDER_SEQ ,WAREHOUSING_TYPE ,ORDER_NO AS WAREHOUSING_NO ,SUM(WAREHOUSING_AMOUNT) AS WAREHOUSING_AMOUNT ,SUM(AMOUNT) AS AMOUNT ,ORDER_EMP_NO ,NULL AS ORDER_EMP_NAME /* ,COMMON_PKG.GET_CODE_NAME(WAREHOUSING_TYPE, 'WT', COMPANY_CODE, {DEFAULT_LANGUAGE}) WAREHOUSING_TYPE_NAME */ , (CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN WAREHOUSING_TYPE = 'IMP' THEN 'N' ELSE COALESCE(COO_TYPE, 'C') END) = 'C' THEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN COALESCE(NONCOO_CNT, 0) > 0 THEN
(SELECT MAX(ECCD.COO_CERTIFY_NO) FROM EXT_COO_CERTIFY_DTL ECCD WHERE ECCD.COO_CERTIFY_NO = COO_CERTIFY_NO AND ECCD.VENDOR_CODE = VENDOR_CODE AND ECCD.DIVISION_CODE = DIVISION_CODE AND ECCD.COMPANY_CODE = COMPANY_CODE AND ECCD.ITEM_CODE = ITEM_CODE AND ECCD.FTA_CODE = (SELECT MAX(FTA_CODE) FROM FTA_MASTER WHERE FTA_CODE = ECCD.FTA_CODE AND COMPANY_CODE = ECCD.COMPANY_CODE) AND ECCD.WAREHOUSING_NO = '-1' AND ECCD.WAREHOUSING_SEQ = '-1' AND WAREHOUSING_DATE BETWEEN ECCD.APPLY_DATE AND ECCD.END_DATE) ELSE NULL END ) ELSE SUM(COALESCE(NONCOO_CNT, 0)) END) AS NONCOO_CNT_BU ,(CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN WAREHOUSING_TYPE ='IMP' THEN 'N' ELSE COALESCE(COO_TYPE, 'C') END) = 'C' THEN COUNT(DISTINCT ORDER_NO) ELSE COUNT(WAREHOUSING_NO) END) AS NONCOO_CNT_TT ,ITEM_CODE ,ITEM_NAME ,COO_CERTIFY_NO /*,TAX_CERT_NO*/ ,MAX(ORIGIN_FILE_NAME) ORIGIN_FILE_NAME ,MAX(FILE_PATH) FILE_PATH FROM (SELECT PL.WAREHOUSING_NO ,PL.SEQ ,D.COMPANY_CODE ,D.DIVISION_GROUP_CODE PU_CODE ,D.DIVISION_CODE ,D.DIVISION_NAME ,V.VENDOR_CODE ,V.VENDOR_NAME ,PL.ORDER_NO ,PL.ORDER_SEQ ,PL.ORDER_EMP_NO /* ,PL.TAX_CERT_NO */ ,PL.WAREHOUSING_TYPE ,SUM(PL.WAREHOUSING_AMOUNT) WAREHOUSING_AMOUNT /*FTA입고금액*/ ,(SUM(PL.WAREHOUSING_AMOUNT)+SUM(COALESCE(PL.TARIFF_AMOUNT, 0))) AMOUNT /*입고금액*/ ,SUM( CASE WHEN PL.COO_CERTIFY_NO is null THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) NONCOO_CNT ,PL.COO_CERTIFY_NO ,PL.COO_TYPE ,PL.ITEM_CODE ,IM.ITEM_NAME ,MAX(ECM.ORIGIN_FILE_NAME) AS ORIGIN_FILE_NAME ,MAX(ECM.FILE_PATH) AS FILE_PATH ,SUBSTR(PL.WAREHOUSING_DATE,1,6)||'01' AS WAREHOUSING_DATE FROM PO_LEDGER PL INNER JOIN DIVISION D ON PL.DIVISION_CODE = D.DIVISION_CODE AND PL.COMPANY_CODE = D.COMPANY_CODE AND PL.DIVISION_CODE = D.DIVISION_CODE /* AND D.DIVISION_GROUP_CODE = '18' [TODO] - 수린 PU_CODE 의미 확인*/ AND D.STATUS = 'Y'
AND D.DIVISION_CODE = #{inv_org}
INNER JOIN VENDOR V ON V.VENDOR_CODE = PL.VENDOR_CODE AND V.COMPANY_CODE = PL.COMPANY_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN EXT_COO_CERTIFY_MST ECM ON ECM.COO_CERTIFY_NO = PL.COO_CERTIFY_NO AND ECM.VENDOR_CODE = PL.VENDOR_CODE AND ECM.DIVISION_CODE = PL.DIVISION_CODE AND ECM.COMPANY_CODE = PL.COMPANY_CODE INNER JOIN ITEM_MST IM ON IM.ITEM_CODE = PL.ITEM_CODE AND IM.COMPANY_CODE = PL.COMPANY_CODE WHERE PL.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code}
AND PL.WAREHOUSING_TYPE = #{warehousing_type}
AND PL.WAREHOUSING_DATE BETWEEN REPLACE(#{start_date}, '-', '') AND REPLACE(#{end_date}, '-', '')
AND UPPER(V.VENDOR_NAME) LIKE UPPER('%' || #{search_keyword} || '%')
AND V.VENDOR_CODE LIKE '%' || #{search_keyword} || '%'
AND PL.ORDER_NO LIKE '%' || #{search_keyword} || '%'
AND UPPER(PL.ITEM_CODE) LIKE UPPER('%' || #{search_keyword} || '%')
AND IM.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%' || #{search_keyword} || '%'
GROUP BY PL.WAREHOUSING_NO ,PL.SEQ ,D.COMPANY_CODE ,D.DIVISION_GROUP_CODE ,D.DIVISION_CODE ,D.DIVISION_NAME ,V.VENDOR_CODE ,V.VENDOR_NAME ,PL.ORDER_NO ,PL.ORDER_SEQ ,PL.ORDER_EMP_NO ,PL.WAREHOUSING_TYPE /*,PL.TAX_CERT_NO*/ ,PL.COO_CERTIFY_NO ,PL.COO_TYPE ,PL.ITEM_CODE ,IM.ITEM_NAME ,SUBSTR(PL.WAREHOUSING_DATE,1,6)) GROUP BY COMPANY_CODE ,PU_CODE ,DIVISION_CODE ,DIVISION_NAME ,VENDOR_CODE ,VENDOR_NAME ,ORDER_NO ,ORDER_SEQ ,WAREHOUSING_TYPE ,ORDER_EMP_NO ,ITEM_CODE ,ITEM_NAME /*,TAX_CERT_NO*/ ,CASE WHEN COO_CERTIFY_NO is null THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ,COO_CERTIFY_NO ,COO_TYPE ,WAREHOUSING_DATE )

SELECT PL.WAREHOUSING_NO ,PL.ORDER_NO ,PL.ORDER_SEQ ,PL.SEQ ,TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(PL.WAREHOUSING_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') WAREHOUSING_DATE ,PL.ITEM_CODE ,IM.ITEM_NAME ,IM.SPEC ,IM.UNIT ,PL.WAREHOUSING_QTY ,PL.UNIT_PRICE ,PL.WAREHOUSING_AMOUNT
,COALESCE(PL.BL_NO,'') BL_NO ,PL.COO_CERTIFY_NO ,PL.COO_TYPE ,PL.DIVISION_CODE ,PL.VENDOR_CODE ,PL.COMPANY_CODE ,V.VENDOR_NAME ,D.DIVISION_NAME ,PL.PRODUCT_NATION_CODE FROM PO_LEDGER PL ,ITEM_MST IM ,VENDOR V ,DIVISION D WHERE 1 = 1
AND PL.DIVISION_CODE = #{inv_org}
AND PL.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND IM.ITEM_CODE = PL.ITEM_CODE AND IM.COMPANY_CODE = PL.COMPANY_CODE AND PL.VENDOR_CODE = V.VENDOR_CODE AND PL.COMPANY_CODE = V.COMPANY_CODE AND PL.COMPANY_CODE = D.COMPANY_CODE AND PL.DIVISION_CODE = D.DIVISION_CODE /* AND D.DIVISION_GROUP_CODE = [todo] 수린 - pu code 확인*/ AND PL.ORDER_NO = #{order_no} AND PL.ORDER_SEQ = #{order_seq} AND PL.ITEM_CODE = #{item_code} AND PL.WAREHOUSING_DATE BETWEEN REPLACE(#{start_date},'-','') AND REPLACE(#{end_date},'-','') ORDER BY PL.ITEM_CODE, WAREHOUSING_DATE
